supportWhatsapp.title: WhatsApp help
supportWhatsapp.description: Link your personal account to adapt guides to your permissions. Included in every plan.
supportWhatsapp.privacy: This is an automated help assistant. It cannot take payments or change your business. Do not send passwords, PINs or card details. Avoqado keeps local message content for up to 30 days; WhatsApp, Meta and the AI provider apply their own policies. Send SALIR to leave, or PERSONA for a human contact.
supportWhatsapp.statusError: We could not check your link. Try again; no change has been confirmed.
supportWhatsapp.requestError: We could not confirm the request. Your form is kept here so you can try again.
supportWhatsapp.off: WhatsApp support has not been activated yet.
supportWhatsapp.unlinkDescription: This removes personalization and erases the local help context linked to your account. Messages already in WhatsApp stay there.
supportWhatsapp.start: First send AYUDA to the support WhatsApp and accept the notice with CONTINUAR. Then request your code here. If the phone is shared, use the public guides without linking it.
supportWhatsapp.phoneError: Enter a valid phone number with country code.
supportWhatsapp.personal: I confirm this WhatsApp is only mine and agree to link it for personalized help.
supportWhatsapp.personalError: Confirm this is your personal WhatsApp.
supportWhatsapp.codeInstructions: Enter the code you received. It expires in 10 minutes. Do not share it or send it in chat.
supportWhatsapp.codeError: Enter the six digits of the code.
